notices.title: Okatazuke Kingdom Is Now Available
notices.body:
Thank you for playing!
We have released Okatazuke Kingdom, where you stand up to King Okatazuke's soldiers with paper companions born from your doodles!

■ Release Celebration Event Now On
Earn event points by playing stages and drawing new companions. Based on the points you collect, you can receive rewards such as coins, materials, and ability books. For details, tap "Release Celebration" at the bottom left of the Home screen.

■ For New Players
Start your adventure from "Stages." If you're not sure how something works, open "Help" on the Home screen to read explanations for each screen.

Enjoy a slightly strange paper battle where your drawings fight just as you drew them!
